name: AppleTart
source:
A Hazbin Hotel fangame where you step into the shoes of Lucifer Morningstar.

Story#1: Lucifer and Charlie stand before their 'new' home – only it’s neither new nor welcoming. Even five-year-old Charlie can tell it’s a health hazard. Lucifer smiles anyway. He has to.

Story#2: A café, a toy store, and one father trying to make his daughter smile.

Story#3: Charlie’s adjusting to a new school, a new home, and a new life. Will Lucifer guide her through it all successfully?

[From [url=https://crowsace.itch.io/appletart]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在《哈兹宾酒店》同人游戏中，你将扮演路西法·晨星的角色。

故事#1：路西法和查理站在他们的“新”家前——只是它既不新也不受欢迎。即使是五岁的查理也知道这对健康有害。路西法还是微笑着。他必须这样做。

故事#2：一家咖啡馆、一家玩具店，一位父亲试图让女儿微笑。

故事#3：查理正在适应新学校、新家和新生活。路西法会成功引导她度过这一切吗？

[来自[url=https://crowsace.itch.io/appletart]Itch.io[/url]]
